# mistershell_ai_guardrail (Data Source)

Reads the effective AI command allowlist toggle for a registered resource type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_ai_guardrail" "ssh" {
  resource_type = "generic_ssh"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allowlist_enabled` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
